question: Can an employee from a different department ask a Product Management question?
short_answer: Yes. Product Management knowledge is retrievable company-wide; only documents marked restricted or management-level require extra authorization.
detailed_answer: MK-Infinite-AI's knowledge base does not gate department knowledge behind the requester's own department. An employee from any department can ask a Product Management question (for example, an IT employee asking about the leave policy). Access is instead controlled per-document via the 'access_level' and 'allowed_departments' metadata, so general employee-facing knowledge remains available company-wide while restricted or management-level documents stay protected.
escalation_path: Associate Product Manager -> Product Manager -> Product Lead -> Head of Product
